## LACD v1.0.1 — patch release

Backward-compatible patch. Fixes real v1.0.0 defects and hardens the release/CI/governance chain.

**Fixed**
- Wheel now ships `templates/` — clean `pip install` + `lacd init` works (was `FileNotFoundError`)
- Release bundle discovery: `parse_template_bundle()` supports three fail-closed formats
- `ENFORCED` no longer a false positive: versioned `EnforcementPolicy` verifies each item; unverifiable → `UNVERIFIED`
- Removed tracked `build/`/`.coverage`; `PRODUCT.md` independence fix

**Added**
- `lacd verify --local` (zero network, for low-privilege adopter CI) / `--remote`
- `status --json`: `dimensions.remote_enforcement.query` (`live|not_queried`)
- `lock.json` `source.commit` + `pin_strength` (`strong|tag-only`)
- `.github/CODEOWNERS`, `llms.txt`, `docs/agents/`, `docs/discoverability/`
- README (EN/ZH) rewritten: positioning, FAQ, limitations — every claim backed by a runnable feature

**Tests**: 370 passed, 1 skipped (live-token) · Full matrix: `docs/v101-acceptance-matrix.md`

**Install**: `pip install "git+https://github.com/SkyCjq/LACD.git@v1.0.1"`

## Template bundle

`lacd-templates-1.0.1.zip` — SHA-256 verified by `lacd upgrade` before use:

```json
{"template_bundle": {"url": "https://github.com/SkyCjq/LACD/releases/download/v1.0.1/lacd-templates-1.0.1.zip", "sha256": "a01c9e4f0227a35ff3755af891962840706bb408b50470c66bf03159e7e7ec51"}}
```
